name: Harmonic Matter
author: Motif
description: Standing-wave membranes in blue-silver with concentrated amber peaks and particles attached to the field. Nine seamless infinite loops.

styles.name: Harmonic Matter Hero
styles.blurb: Three stacked silver membranes ring with a standing wave; amber peaks and attached particles follow the field.

amp.label: Amplitude
amp.hint: Peak height of the surface in scene units.

wavelength.label: Wavelength
wavelength.hint: Base spatial wavelength in scene units. Short = fine ripples, long = broad swells.

tilt.label: Camera pitch
tilt.hint: Elevation of the camera above the surface, radians.

nodeWidth.label: Node width
nodeWidth.hint: Width of the glowing nodal contours, measured on the surface.

opacity.label: Membrane opacity
opacity.hint: How much each thin sheet covers what lies beneath.

warmth.label: Peak warmth
warmth.hint: Amber light concentrated on the wave peaks.

density.label: Particle density
density.hint: Fraction of lattice cells that hold a particle.

drift.label: Particle drift
drift.hint: Displacement along the field gradient. Follows the same wave.

orbit.label: Camera orbit
orbit.hint: Closed yaw excursion of the camera.

keyAngle.label: Key direction
keyAngle.hint: Direction of the key light in the picture plane, degrees.

exposure.label: Exposure
exposure.hint: Linear exposure before the single tone map.

bloom.label: Bloom
bloom.hint: Glow added around emissive light. 0 shows the bare geometry.

bloomRadius.label: Bloom radius
bloomRadius.hint: Width of the glow relative to the frame.

lensCA.label: Edge fringe
lensCA.hint: Spectral fringing toward the frame edge.

vignette.label: Vignette
vignette.hint: Darkens the frame edge; never touches the focal area.

quality.label: Quality
quality.hint: Sample counts only. Composition, phase and exposure stay the same.
